# Antoine Oparin

> Antoine Oparin is a software developer in Montréal and a Computer Science student at Concordia University. He builds real-time, full-stack software with Java, Spring Boot, React and TypeScript, and is open to new opportunities.

- Contact: antoineoparin@gmail.com
- Location: Montréal, Québec, Canada
- Languages: Java, TypeScript, JavaScript, C#, Kotlin, SQL (PostgreSQL), NoSQL (MongoDB), HTML, CSS
- Frameworks and libraries: Spring Boot, React, Node.js, .NET, Tailwind CSS, Flask, Express, Next.js
- Tools: Git, Docker, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Visual Studio, VS Code, Linux, Google Colab

**Experience**

- **TS Imagine**, Software Developer Intern, Fixed Income (Apr - Jul 2026, Montréal): Worked on the Fixed Income Order Execution Management System, moving legacy apps onto the company's Spring Boot and React architecture. Modernized 3 legacy GWT/GXT applications into Spring Boot microservices, owned the Server-Sent Events feature streaming real-time order updates to the React frontend, built 15+ reusable React/TypeScript components adopted by 2+ teams, and turned 40+ migration prompts and workflows into a reusable Claude Code skill.

**Education**

- **Concordia University**, Bachelor of Computer Science (Sep 2026 - May 2029, current)
- **Dawson College**, DEC in Computer Science Technology (Aug 2023 - May 2026)

## Projects

- [Ramifie](https://ramifie.com): Daily crossword-style word puzzle about building one connected grid of valid words (2025 - present). 50+ recurring players; time-to-playable on 3G cut from 2.5s to 1.9s. React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, AWS Lambda, Cloudflare Pages, GitHub Actions.
- [ToneBridge](https://github.com/AntoineOparin/ToneBridge): Perfect-pitch training game built with a team of 3 at DawsHacks 2026. In-browser pitch detection, a 10-level note curriculum and real-time Socket.io duels with ELO ratings. React, TypeScript, Node.js, Socket.io, PostgreSQL.
- [NetWatch](https://github.com/AntoineOparin/netwatch): Home network monitor answering "why is my Xbox lagging?" (2026). Go agents stream bandwidth, per-app usage and Wi-Fi signal to a hub that detects lag, separates Wi-Fi problems from ISP congestion and names the computer and app responsible. Go, TypeScript, React, SQLite, Protobuf, GitHub Actions.
- [Hair Salon Appointments](https://gitlab.com/thomas-k/dw-420w25sec1-prj-grp3-koleboshyna): School project. Full-stack appointment and reporting system for a hair salon. React, Flask, PostgreSQL, Docker, Python, JavaScript.
- [Fireworks Simulator](https://gitlab.com/dawson-cst-cohort-2026/510/section1/oparin/fireworks): School project. Modular particle-system simulator and reusable rendering libraries for fireworks. C#, .NET 8, MSTest, MonoGame.
